# Fluence.Wpf from PowerShell

This page has moved. The PowerShell documentation now lives under [docs/powershell/](powershell/README.md): a [tutorial](powershell/tutorial.md), how-to guides, one [reference](powershell/reference/README.md) page per cmdlet of the `Fluence.Wpf.PowerShell` module, and an [explanation](powershell/explanation.md) of its design. The bare `Add-Type` bootstrap that used to be on this page, with the four `Fluence.Wpf.Demo.PowerShell` scripts, is now [Use the library without the module](powershell/how-to/raw-library-without-the-module.md).
